blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Office of Vice President Sara Duterte on Saturday denied allegations linking its tree-planting initiative to Cale88 Foods Corp.’s compliance with Board of Investments (BOI) requirements. In a statement, the OVP said attempts to link Duterte’s involvement in the “PagbaBAGo: A Million Trees Campaign” to Cale88’s obligation to plant 100 trees to qualify for incentives were “misleading, malicious, and [have] no factual basis.” READ: Prosec asks if VP’s tree-planting was tied to Cale88 requirement The statement came after House prosecutors on Friday questioned defense witness Trade Undersecretary Ceferino Rodolfo during Duterte’s Senate impeachment trial on whether the vice […]...
